limitations: Even in these enlarged quadrant images, the font's T-shaped qamats is hard to tell apart from a patach with a meteg. Many of primary's metegs (כְּנַֽחַל, שָֽׁעַר, הַיַּֽעַר, וָשַֽׁיִת, זַֽיִת, וְהֶאֱמִירָֽנוּ) may be qamats stems that were misread.

Possible metegs before hatafs (for example לַֽעֲשׂוֹת, בַּֽעֲצֵי, רַֽעֲנָן, אַֽהֲבָתוֹ, נַֽחֲלָה, הֶֽאֱמַרְנוּהוּ, כְּצִֽפֳּרִים, לְמַֽאֲכָל, מְיַֽחֲלָיו) could not be checked one by one. Their absence is not verified.
Dageshes in small-type stanzas (for example the ל in בִּגְדֻלָּתוֹ and the ד in לַדְּבֵקִים) are faint.
The running head and page number are not visible in these eight detail images. No source notes appear on the page.
Primary has many consonant-level misreadings, so it is unreliable as a guide to metegs. No primary meteg could be verified to a confident standard.
